name: CUDA 1D Volume Mapper with Adaptive Step Size and Shading
aliases: Adaptive Ray Casting with Gradient-Based Shading
definition: A GPU-based volume rendering method that casts rays through a 3D volume, using an adaptive step size to skip empty space and compute photorealistic shading (Phong-Lambert) based on volume gradients. It uses 1D transfer functions for opacity and color, and early ray termination for performance.
summary: This GPU volume rendering method uses adaptive step sizes to skip empty space and gradient-based shading for photorealism, improving gradient estimation by backtracking in opaque regions.
